summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatting entry (\x1b]0;{title}\x07) and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) gated only on is_terminal, returning True/False; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200; one test added to each of test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Tests and mypy were not run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. Nothing committed.
